turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
Here is a worked example. Every day I go to school. Yesterday I ___ to school.
Step 1: go does not take -ed.
Step 2: its past form is a new word: went.
Result: Yesterday I went to school.
The rule: some verbs change to a new word in the past instead of adding -ed.
Right: Last week I saw a film. Wrong: Last week I seed a film.
Now you. Write the past form of 'have': Yesterday I ___ a big lunch.
